The '''Scourge''' was a faction of the [[White Maw]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] gang during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and the [[Galactic War]]. They and the [[Marauders (White Maw)|Marauders]] were one of several gangs that struck a deal with [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Layek Davos]] to escort him to the ''[[Starbreeze]]'' on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]].<ref name="Assault on the Starbreeze">{{TORcite|type=class|[[Cipher Nine|Imperial Agent]]|Assault on the Starbreeze|[[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]}}</ref>
